jobs.jd: Construim o echipa in Romania pentru branduri globale. Lucram deja cu branduri din SUA, Romania si Middle East si vrem sa demonstram ca nu trebuie sa fii in Londra sau New York ca sa faci work la cel mai inalt nivel. International Waters e un studio creativ independent, nascut in Bucuresti si construit de la inceput pentru work global. Peste 70% din clientii nostri sunt internationali. Avem biroul langa Herastrau si lucram hybrid. Cautam intuitie, curiozitate si ambitie. Mandatories: Engleza la nivel avansat, scris si vorbit. Aplicatiile doar cu CV nu vor fi luate in calcul. Pasiune reala pentru publicitate. Oameni care inteleg importanta craftului, nu doar a gandului din spate. Care construiesc pe insight-uri, nu doar pe prompturi de chat gpt. Specializare: Art, Copywriter, Digital, Marketing.

jobs.role: AI Research Lab UI/UX & Brand Designer (100 % remote) (m/f/d)
jobs.jd: Lead the end-to-end UI/UX design process for new AI research initiatives, from conceptualization and wireframing through high-fidelity prototyping and user testing. Develop and implement brand guidelines and visual identities for the AI Research Lab and individual projects. Translate complex AI concepts and research findings into intuitive, user-friendly interfaces. Architect scalable design systems and components adaptable across AI products and platforms. Required experience: 5-10 years of professional experience in UI/UX and brand design, described as a Senior to Principal-level role. Bachelor's degree in Graphic Design, HCI, Interaction Design or related field; master's preferred. Figma, Sketch, Adobe Creative Suite required.
jobs.notes: Postat 2026-09-25. 100% remote, worldwide; listed under Bucharest, Romania. Requires candidates located in Europe or the Americas. Application requires: 100% remote.

jobs.jd: Conceptualize, design, and execute KPI-measured creative campaigns across paid social, display, search, OOH, and partner channels. Translate marketing objectives and complex financial-product features into engaging visual solutions for fintech and B2B audiences. Develop scalable campaign templates for asset rollouts, sales presentations, and marketing collateral to maintain brand consistency and improve production efficiency. Maintain templates and design-system components that support a cohesive brand identity and rapid asset creation. Organize and optimize design workflows, asset management, collaboration, and output quality using appropriate tools and processes. Apply financial-promotion standards, using approved claims libraries and risk warnings as defined inputs for creative development. Use campaign-performance data and KPIs to inform design decisions and optimize acquisition and conversion. Experience level/range: 2-5 years; mid-level. At least 2 years of dedicated design experience. Strong preference for fintech or financial-services experience, including trading platforms, SaaS, or related sectors. B2B marketing or B2B-focused brand experience is advantageous. No specific degree is mandatory; Graphic Design, Visual Communications, Marketing, or a related educational background is beneficial. Figma, Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign) required. Familiarity with AI-powered design tools, integrations, plugins, or workflow automation.
jobs.notes: Postat 2026-09-14. Remote solely, Romania. Full-time contractor. Mid-level (2-5 ani), dar rolul are componenta strategica si de design system.
